items.title: Add support for customizing Astral mirror URLs
items.reason: The May 18–19 follow-up comments describe this exact unresolved gap: standalone installers ignore UV_ASTRAL_MIRROR_URL, while UV_DOWNLOAD_URL requires knowing the version even when fetching the latest installer through an Astral proxy. They include the same URL-selection branches for 0.11.14.

items.title: Add Astral mirror URL override
items.reason: Released in 0.11.14, this implemented the mirror setting and closed astral-sh/uv#18525. Self-update explicitly passes a versioned UV_DOWNLOAD_URL to the installer; the change did not add direct support to the shell or PowerShell templates.

items.title: Publish installers to `/installers/uv/latest` on the mirror
items.reason: Provides stable latest-installer URLs on releases.astral.sh, supporting installation without specifying a version. It changes script publication, not artifact URL selection inside the scripts, so it does not resolve the missing mirror override.

related.search_scope: Used authenticated gh to search open and closed issues and open, closed, and merged PRs. Literal searches covered UV_ASTRAL_MIRROR_URL, UV_DOWNLOAD_URL, INSTALLER_DOWNLOAD_URL, UV_INSTALLER_GITHUB_BASE_URL, and UV_INSTALLER_GHE_BASE_URL. Conceptual searches covered installer mirrors, proxy repositories, base URLs, latest-version installation, self-update mirrors, and cargo-dist sources, without platform/version restrictions. Fix-oriented PR text searches returned no hits; issue timelines supplied the merged changes inspected directly. Reviewed candidate comments, referenced discussions, implementation diffs, release timing, published 0.12.23 installers, and cargo-dist templates. Ruled out astral-sh/uv#22264 (success-message URL) and astral-sh/uv#22265 (Windows NO_PROXY handling) as duplicates. Historical astral-sh/uv#9134, astral-sh/uv#16519, and astral-sh/uv#17255 concern earlier self-update metadata/server limitations; astral-sh/uv#18503 and astral-sh/uv#18682 concern adopting the default Astral mirror.

type_reason: The exact direct-installer problem and version-independent Astral-proxy requirement already appear in the post-closure discussion of astral-sh/uv#18525. That discussion can centralize this unresolved gap. This is not an established regression: the same omission was reported immediately after mirror support shipped in 0.11.14, and astral-sh/uv#19206 supported self-update by supplying UV_DOWNLOAD_URL rather than changing the standalone templates.
summary: astral-sh/uv#18525 contains the same unresolved installer request. astral-sh/uv#19206 explains existing self-update support; astral-sh/uv#18725 provides stable latest-installer URLs. The required README update failed because /home/runner/work/_temp/issue-context/README.md is on a read-only filesystem.
draft_response:
You're right: both 0.12.23 standalone scripts omit UV_ASTRAL_MIRROR_URL. The same gap—including installing the latest version through a releases.astral.sh proxy without specifying the version—is discussed in the May 18–19 comments on astral-sh/uv#18525. Please continue the installer-specific discussion there; although the broader issue was closed, that follow-up remains unresolved.

For self-update, astral-sh/uv#19206 already passes a versioned UV_DOWNLOAD_URL to the installer. Directly invoking the scripts lacks that step.

The scripts are generated by cargo-dist. For your proposed contribution, the shell and PowerShell sources are installer.sh.j2 and installer.ps1.j2 under https://github.com/axodotdev/cargo-dist/tree/v0.32.0/cargo-dist/templates/installer. Those templates are the starting point for adding direct mirror support.
